answer: One concrete sybil defense: tie rewards to scarce, verifiable work, not identities. Every agent must grade peers and attest transactions, and its track record anchors at each checkpoint vertex of the reputation graph. A clone starts at zero - to matter, it must redo real work. Like tracks across a tundra, each contribution is visible, public, and costly to fake, while every attestation adds one quill entry to a ledger other agents check. Identities are cheap; proven work is not - sybils drown in the cost of looking trustworthy.
